blocks.tamil_translation: I was sick, and you did not visit Me?” Allah Ta'ala will say. The servant will say, “O my Lord! How could I visit You? You are the Lord of the worlds (You are free from the defect of sickness).” Allah Ta'ala will say, “Did you not know that such-and-such servant of Mine was sick? You did not visit him. Did you not know that had you visited him, you would have found Me there?” Allah Ta'ala will say, “O son of Adam! I asked you for food, and you did not give Me food.” The servant will say, “O my Lord! How could I feed You? You are the Lord of the worlds.' Allah Ta'ala will say, “Such-and-such servant of Mine asked you for food and you did not give him food; did you not know that had you given him food, you would have obtained its reward with Me?” Allah Ta'ala will say, “O son of Adam! I asked you for water, and you did not give Me water.” The servant will say, “O my Lord! How could I give You water? You are the Lord of the worlds.' Allah Ta'ala will say, “Such-and-such servant of Mine asked you for water to drink and you did not give him water to drink; had you given him water to drink, you would have obtained its reward with Me,” — so the Prophet ﷺ said, as narrated by Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA).

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: اِذَا صَنَعَ لِأَحَدِكُمْ خَادِمُهُ طَعَامَهُ ثُمَّ جَاءَهُ بِهِ، وَقَدْ وَلِيَ حَرَّهُ وَدُخَانَهُ، فَلْيُقْعِدْهُ مَعَهُ، فَلْيَأْكُلْ، فَاِنْ كَانَ الطَّعَامُ مَشْفُوْهًا قَلِيْلاً، فَلْيَضَعْ فِيْ يَدِهِ مِنْهُ اُكْلَةً اَوْ اُكْلَتَيْنِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم، باب اطعام المملوك مما ياكل...، رقم:٤٣١٧
